Shell_PendingModule: This module is part of the v2 migration plan and will be enabled after the current operations foundation is validated.
Servers_AgentlessHelp: VPS Desk connects directly over SSH; no VPS Desk agent is installed on the server.
Servers_HostFingerprintHelp: When supplied, VPS Desk rejects a server whose SSH host key does not match.
Dashboard_PerformanceHelp: CPU and memory · live samples · auto refresh 10s after first successful connection
Dashboard_RecentActivityHelp: Deployments and important VPS Desk operations are stored locally and shown here.
Dashboard_NoRecentActivity: There is no recorded activity yet.
Containers_Subtitle: Inventory and live stats are read directly over SSH. No Docker API port is exposed.
Containers_ActionHelp: Start, stop and restart require an explicit confirmation.
Containers_SafetyNote: Container deletion, image pruning and volume removal are intentionally not exposed here yet.
Deployments_Subtitle: Guarded Git + Docker Compose workflow with preflight and post-deploy verification.
Deployments_HistoryHelp: Persistent local record of deployments performed by VPS Desk.
Deployments_RemoteRepositoryTooltip: Path inside the VPS where the project is already cloned (e.g. /root/my-app). This is where git and docker compose run for the deployment.
Deployments_SaveProfileTooltip: Saves path, branch, Compose and non-sensitive options for the active server. Passwords, keys and secrets are never saved.
Deployments_ProjectPlaceholder: Choose a Compose project discovered on the VPS
Deployments_ExecuteTooltip: Discovers options when needed and validates the VPS before asking for final confirmation. It does not modify containers until you confirm.
Deployments_DiscoverTooltip: Connects over SSH and reads which branches and *.yml files actually exist in the remote repository.
Deployments_PullSourceTooltip: Runs fetch, checkout and pull --ff-only on the selected branch without deploying or restarting containers.
Deployments_RunPreflightTooltip: Checks SSH, installed tools, branch, compose file and environment before changing the server.
Deployments_WorkflowHelp: Choose Deploy: VPS Desk discovers and validates automatically. It asks for confirmation only before changing the server.
Deployments_BranchTooltip: Git branch to deploy (the server does git fetch/checkout/pull on this branch).
Deployments_BranchPlaceholder: Choose a branch discovered on the server
Deployments_ComposeFileTooltip: docker-compose*.yml file in the remote repository that defines the services to bring up.
Deployments_ComposePlaceholder: Choose a Compose file discovered on the server
Deployments_RequireEnvTooltip: When on, the deployment stops if this .env file does not exist on the server.
Deployments_PullImagesTooltip: Pulls Docker images referenced by the compose file before starting.
Deployments_BuildImagesTooltip: Rebuilds images defined in Compose before starting them.
Deployments_CleanBuildCacheTooltip: Runs docker builder prune -f after Compose is applied. Enabled by default; a cleanup failure is recorded as a warning and does not invalidate an otherwise healthy deployment.
Deployments_HealthUrls: HTTP health URLs after deployment (optional, one per line)
Deployments_HealthHelp: Checks run from the VPS after Compose finishes. No Holos/ABP endpoint is hardcoded.
Deployments_ProcessHelp: Each completed command appears here while the deployment runs.
Deployments_PostDeployHelp: Container state/health plus optional HTTP smoke checks.
Deployments_OutputHelp: Git fetch/checkout/fast-forward → optional image pull → Compose up → Compose status → optional cache cleanup → postflight verification
Logs_Subtitle: Read Docker logs and systemd journal entries directly over SSH.
Storage_Subtitle: Disk, Docker storage, cleanup and large directories.
Storage_CleanupHelp: Destructive operations always require confirmation. VPS Desk never removes Docker volumes unless you explicitly opt in.
Storage_HeavyDirectoriesHelp: Top directories scanned on the same filesystem without installing an agent.
Storage_CleanupConfirmation: Review exactly what will be removed before continuing.
Storage_CleanupSafety: Running containers are not removed by Docker prune. Full cleanup can remove stopped containers, unused networks, unused images and build cache. Volumes are preserved unless explicitly selected.
Files_Subtitle: SFTP file explorer for the active VPS. No desktop environment or agent is installed on the server.
Files_RemoteDirectoryHelp: Compact explorer view · folders first · open the selected entry
Files_EditorHelp: Protected remote editor for configuration and text files up to 2 MB. JSON and XML are validated before saving.
Files_NoEditor: Select a text file to open the editor.
Files_SensitiveWarning: Potentially sensitive file. VPS Desk does not expose or log its contents outside this editor; review secrets, connection strings and credentials carefully before saving.
Files_ConflictProtection: Before writing, VPS Desk reads the remote file again. If it changed since you opened it, save is blocked to avoid overwriting external changes.
Files_ReadOnlyBanner: Read-only mode. Turn on "Edit anyway" to modify this file.
Files_EnvManagerHelp: Edit the .env as name/value pairs. VPS Desk preserves comments, unknown lines and existing order; .bak backup and external-change protection remain active when saving.
Security_Subtitle: Read-only exposure and SSH posture checks. VPS Desk does not change firewall or sshd configuration from this screen.

Backups_RestoreDbSafety: First save a backup of the current database on the VPS (recommended)
